schema: hierarchical v1: module tree + one wiring graph per class forward() (graphart/hier.py)

timm_test.rule: DLA, CSPNet, GhostNet (two sizes each); a family that does not trace losslessly is replaced by the next of HRNet, ReXNet, SelecSLS -- fixed before building

training_exclusions.why: holdout architectures (Swin, MaxViT, MViT) and the timm test families are never trained on
training_exclusions.generator: programs whose variant graphs are isomorphic to a whole holdout/timm-test program's are rejected

rules: Holdout and timm_test are scored ONCE, on the frozen setup, after a dated amendment to this file fixes the pipeline, the models and the comparisons -- written before any reply on them exists.
Never tune prompts, data, the generator or training on them; never generate replies on them before the amendment; never print or read their content while developing (the builder prints counts only).
The 17-sample flat holdout (FROZEN.json) stays spent and is not part of this protocol.
Caveat recorded at freezing: the holdout constructors were traced once on 19 Nov in a count of all torchvision models (counts only, no content looked at).

amendments.reason: assembler fix: real-code samples now include the plain classes (config dataclasses, not weight enums) and module-level constants their code uses; before, e.g. EfficientNet's MBConvConfig -- the only reference to MBConv -- and VGG's cfgs were missing. Found 21 Nov by a static undefined-name check on dev and timm training data; no holdout or timm-test content was looked at, and no reply on either set exists.
